contea di ritrovamento: East Riding of Yorkshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy Coin. Radiate indeterminate, probably issue of 260-275, Reece period 13. Obverse description: Radiate bust cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: IMP C[---]. Reverse description: Soldier standing left with shield and spear. Reverse inscription: [---]S [--]V[--]. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin. Diameter: 19.2mm, Weight: 1.60gms, die axis: 12
